name: Temecula Town Center
summary: Temecula Town Center is a sprawling open-air shopping complex in the heart of Temecula's wine country, featuring a major department store anchor, boutiques, services, and diverse dining options. This popular community destination serves both local residents and tourists with convenient shopping and a welcoming atmosphere.
demographics: Temecula Town Center serves the growing Temecula Valley community, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals in the 25-54 age range. The trade area draws from Temecula's rapidly expanding suburban population, which includes many families with children seeking convenient shopping and dining options. Visitors typically exhibit lifestyle-oriented shopping patterns, combining errands with dining and entertainment activities in this wine country region of Southwest Riverside County.
description: Temecula Town Center is a sprawling shopping complex located at 27540 Ynez Road in the heart of Temecula's wine country region. This open-air community center features a diverse mix of boutiques, services, and eateries alongside a major department store anchor, creating a convenient one-stop destination for residents and visitors to the Temecula Valley. The center's design emphasizes accessibility and ease of shopping, with ample parking and a layout that encourages browsing multiple stores in a single visit. Managed by Colliers on behalf of the ownership group, Temecula Town Center maintains high standards for tenant quality and visitor experience, with regular updates to safety practices and amenities. The center's strong 4.4-star rating from nearly 3,000 Google reviews reflects its popularity as a reliable shopping destination that serves the daily needs of the growing Temecula community while also attracting tourists exploring Southern California's wine country.
